subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Truthfulness is (i) engaged in preaching the truth (b) Although it may not (ii) the whole world to peace and progress. (c) All the great men were (iii) forbidden in all religions (d) Truthfulness may lead (iv) formed the habit at boyhood (e) A man who speaks (v) the greatest of all virtues the truth in a man's life (vi) make one rich but it brings peace of mind (vii) gets respect from all
